issues.message: Headline 'BUY ETFs COMMISSION FREE' is clipped on the right edge of the canvas — only 'BUY ETFs COMMISSION FRE' is visible, with the final 'E' cut off.
CTA pill extends past the right canvas edge; the label 'START INVESTING' is clipped to 'START INVE' with 'STING' overflowing or rendered outside the pill background.
CTA pill has effectively zero right-side padding from the canvas edge, well under the 16px minimum.
Because the CTA label is clipped and the headline is truncated, the intended reading order (headline → CTA) is degraded; the eye is drawn to broken text rather than the value proposition.

notes: Variant appears nearly identical to the source, but the source itself exhibits the same clipping problems on headline and CTA at 1200x628. Brand palette, logo, and disclaimer are preserved correctly.
